facts.fact: Loi n° 39/AN/19/8ème L, published 21 January 2019 (Journal officiel no. 2 of 31 January 2019), is an Assembly law creating the NNI and the national register of natural persons; the Direction générale de la population et de la famille runs the register and ANSIE its technical management.
facts.system: Loi n° 39/AN/19/8ème L (2019, national identification number and national register of persons)

facts.fact: The law creates a unique, unambiguous NNI (Art. 4) and a national register forming a central file of biographic and biometric data (Art. 11), the single reference for the ID card, travel documents and other secure documents (Art. 12).
